title: Paul Skenes - SMLB-27 Stars Of MLB - 2025 Topps Series 1 Pittsburgh Pirates
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a Paul Skenes trading card from the 2025 Topps Series 1 set featuring the Pittsburgh Pirates. This sports trading card is part of the Major League Baseball (MLB) league and is a base set card with card number SMLB-27. The card does not feature an autograph but is manufactured by Topps and showcases the player/athlete Paul Skenes from the Pittsburgh Pirates team. It is a sought-after collectible for fans of baseball and trading card enthusiasts.
